decisions.briefing: Markets were quietly positive today with NASDAQ +0.4% and S&P 500 +0.5%, a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($289.29) sits below the $500 threshold for new positions, so per strategy memory we're holding rather than forcing a buy — waiting for a clearer risk-on setup before deploying the remaining capital.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the S&P 500 slightly outpacing the NASDAQ in a quiet, low-volatility session. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a market in a holding pattern rather than a strong trending day. Trading volume and sector leadership were unremarkable, reinforcing the neutral read on conditions.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，標普500表現略勝納指一籌，成交淡靜，波動有限。市場並無明顯單一催化因素帶動走勢，反映投資者觀望氣氛濃厚而非趨勢性上升。成交量及板塊表現均平平無奇，符合「中性」市況的判斷。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today our cash balance was below the threshold needed to safely open a new position, so instead of forcing a trade, the portfolio held that cash in reserve for a better setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是投資者預留在場邊、待有良好機會時才動用的現金。今日現金水平未達到開新倉的安全門檻，因此組合選擇保留現金，等待更佳的入市時機，而非勉強交易。
